race.comment: COMMANCHE JACK (6) was a last start winner (19.29) at this track who is building a strong winning record. Form here at the trip excellent including five wins. Winner at his latest appearance in one of the quickest times on the card. Hard to go past. SANTANA BOY (4) lines up chasing another win after getting around the 350m at this track in a strong 19.28 on September 27. Bold showing expected again. SIN CITY NIGHTS (8) was in the placings last time but shapes well for this on his flying win the start prior, getting around Warragul over 400m in 22.56. Smart winner two back and looks a key chance on that form. ASCEND IGLOO (1) is a chance after winning last time.
